description: Use when the user asks whether a Steam account has a VAC, game, community or trade (economy) ban - the first check for a cheating report or before trusting a player. Returns VACBanned, NumberOfVACBans, NumberOfGameBans, DaysSinceLastBan, CommunityBanned and EconomyBan exactly as Steam reports them; DaysSinceLastBan is 0 both for banned today and never banned. Unresolvable ids or an unavailable upstream return an error result, never guessed data. Do not use for FACEIT bans (steam_faceit).

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_bans

bans.description: Steam ban object: VACBanned, NumberOfVACBans, NumberOfGameBans, DaysSinceLastBan, CommunityBanned, EconomyBan

provenance.description: freshness of the ban snapshot: retrieved_at, age_seconds, fresh, cache_ttl

title: Steam ban check
